_comment: Run template for synthetic-g36-vav-fleet (generated by CAMBER, no real building): eight VAV air handlers (AHU__<scenario>), each with six single-duct reheat boxes (VAV1__<scenario> .. VAV6__<scenario>), hourly, at the rules' defaults. The topology declares which boxes each air handler serves, so the rogue-zone and cohort-starvation censuses group by air handler (grouping_provenance explicit). Per equipment: sat_ and static_reset_effectiveness on each air handler (setpoint against the T&R trajectory its own request count implies), reheat_minimization_g36 on each box. Fleet rules, one finding on <fleet> that camber datasets score cannot score: the SAT and static rogue-zone censuses, the SAT and static cohort-starvation censuses, cohort_airflow compared within each air handler (group_by_topology: box sizes differ, so a building-wide comparison of mean airflow finds nothing), cohort_space_temp across all 48 boxes, and zones_heat_cool_census, which pools every box building-wide. Measured: AHU__not_responding's SAT reset is stuck (0.06 F of swing against an expected 10) and its static reset not responding; every other reset is effective. The SAT census names VAV1__rogue_sat (98.9% of its air handler's requests), the static census VAV5__rogue_static (95.9%) and lists VAV1__rogue_sat as overloaded (short of cooling, not a starved inlet); SAT cohort starvation names AHU__not_responding, static cohort starvation AHU__not_responding and AHU__starved; cohort_airflow flags VAV1__rogue_sat and VAV5__rogue_static, cohort_space_temp VAV1__rogue_sat and five of AHU__not_responding's boxes; reheat_minimization_g36 faults on VAV2__reheat, VAV4__reheat and VAV1-5__heat_cool; zones_heat_cool_census faults (98.3% of occupied hours have a zone heating while another cools). Run one air handler alone with the exercise variants (zone-g36-fleet--healthy and the others), each of which keeps the equipment of one scenario.
